court_model: assumed high-school-style 84x50 ft court, with centre line y=42 ft and centre circle radius 6 ft; it is not a new production sport key

image_centre_circle_ellipse.fraction_method: single-labeller visual arc accounting: visible left and lower arcs plus short right and upper segments; logo and players obscure the remainder

solver.objective: two normalised line correspondences plus normalised conic-coefficient correspondence; the fitted residual is an optimisation diagnostic, not validation evidence
